name: Gambling Hall
desc1: This square chamber is filled with dice tables and gambling dwarves.
desc2: Against one wall are a row of strange dwarven machines, of wood and
desc3: metal, which consist of a box with three small windows in it and a
desc4: pull-lever. Inside each window is a little picture; in the side of the
desc5: machine is a slot for coins. A huge wooden sign on one wall posts the
desc6: wagers and rules. Some tables stand near the exit, for patrons to
desc7: drink and get back their strength for another round of gambling.
